remediation.fix_approach: Added CSS comment injection (/*) and hex-escape (\XX) blocking patterns to the value regex in getCss() in both field.component.ts and input-field.component.ts, alongside the existing url()/expression()/javascript: guards.
remediation.root_cause: The regex /url\s*\(|expression\s*\(/i validated CSS property values but did not block CSS comment injection (url/**/) or Unicode hex escapes (jav\61script:). These bypass techniques could defeat the guard if a url()-capable property were ever added to the ALLOWED_CSS_PROPS allowlist.
changes_made: src/app/mini-components/field/field.component.ts: added /\/\*/ and /\\[0-9a-fA-F]/ checks in getCss() value validation
src/app/mini-components/input-field/input-field.component.ts: same two checks added in getCss() value validation
remediation.verification_needed: Verify that CSS property values containing CSS comments (/* */) or backslash hex escapes (\61) are now filtered out. Confirm normal color/font/border values still pass through.
remediation.defense_in_depth: ALLOWED_CSS_PROPS does not include any url()-capable property — this is the primary defense. The regex guards are a defense-in-depth layer protecting against future allowlist expansion.
remediation.testing: Manual: test field.style containing 'color: jav\61script:alert(1)' and 'color: red; background-image: url/**/(evil)' — both should be filtered. Normal 'color: red' should pass.
remediation.residual_risk: Low. Bypass is currently theoretical (allowlist has no url()-capable properties). Fix closes the future-expansion window.
